limitations_and_boundaries: The method was validated only in cell lines (HEK293T, Jurkat, K562) and not in primary cells or in vivo.
The TCR screen was a proof-of-concept and not a comprehensive genome-wide screen.
gRNA assignment confidence depends on transcriptome quality; cells with low gene detection may be unassigned.
Multiple gRNA assignments increase with detected genes per cell, likely due to cell doublets.
The study does not include a rescue experiment to confirm causal roles of identified genes.
The selected source chunks do not report a rescue, reconstitution, reversal, or epistasis experiment; that rung of the causal evidence chain remains untested within this extraction scope.

methods.name: CROP-seq library construction
methods.protocol_description: CROPseq-Guide-Puro plasmid assembled from four PCR products using ligase cycling reaction. Lentivirus produced and cells transduced. Single-cell RNA-seq performed using Drop-seq protocol with modifications: droplet breaking using perfluoroctanol and syringe filtration through 0.22 µm filter, reverse transcription and exonuclease I treatment as in original Drop-seq, cDNA enrichment for 4+10 cycles, Nextera XT library preparation with additional enrichment cycles.

methods.name: Single-cell sequencing data preprocessing
methods.protocol_description: Data processed with Drop-seq Tools v1.12. Read2 tagged with cell barcode (bases 1-12) and UMI (bases 13-20), trimmed, aligned with STAR v2.4.0 to human genome (GRCh38) extended with CROPseq-Guide-Puro plasmid sequences. Cell barcodes corrected for bead synthesis errors (up to 4 bases). UMI-deduplicated reads per gene per cell used to build digital expression matrix for cells with ≥500 genes. gRNA assignment: most abundant gRNA per cell; for Jurkat screen, cells with purity >0.9 retained.

methods.name: Bulk RNA-seq preprocessing
methods.protocol_description: Reads trimmed with Trimmomatic, aligned to GRCh38 with Bowtie1 (parameters: -q -p 6 -a -m 100 -minins 0 -maxins 5000 -fr -sam -chunkmbs 200), duplicates removed with Picard MarkDuplicates, transcript quantification with BitSeq using MCMC, gene-level expression from most highly expressed transcript, TPM and log transformed.

methods.name: Transcriptome signature analysis
methods.protocol_description: Pairwise distances (L2-norm) between gRNAs using median expression of single cells with same gRNA; significance assessed with Mann-Whitney U test. For gene-level, combined gRNA P values with Fisher's method. Sparse transcriptome signatures used to position single cells along a trajectory of cell states (TCR activation).

methods.name: TCR screen CROP-seq experiment
methods.protocol_description: Jurkat cells stably expressing Cas9 transduced with lentivirus from CROPseq-Guide-Puro gRNA library. Genome-edited cells selected with puromycin. At day 10 post-transduction, cells serum starved, split, and subjected to TCR stimulation via anti-CD3 and anti-CD28 antibodies or continued starvation. Both populations analyzed with CROP-seq.
